description: This PHP source file contains the implementation of the URI class within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library. It defines a PSR-7 compliant URI object with methods for parsing, composing, and manipulating URI components, following RFC 3986. The class includes constants, properties, constructor, various static methods for URI operations, and instance methods for accessing and modifying URI parts.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing URI parsing, construction, validation, and manipulation functionalities in accordance with RFC 3986. It includes methods for retrieving URI components, creating modified copies, and static utilities for URI operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new URI object, optionally parsing an initial URI string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the URI by composing its components.

methods.name: composeComponents
methods.description: Static method that builds a URI string from individual components such as scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: isDefaultPort
methods.description: Checks if the given URI has the default port for its scheme.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Determines if the URI is absolute based on the presence of a scheme.

methods.name: isNetworkPathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a network-path reference, starting with '//' and lacking a scheme.

methods.name: isAbsolutePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is an absolute-path reference, beginning with a single '/'.

methods.name: isRelativePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a relative path reference, not starting with '/'.

methods.name: isSameDocumentReference
methods.description: Determines if the URI is a same-document reference relative to a base URI.

methods.name: removeDotSegments
methods.description: Removes dot segments from a path, delegating to UriResolver::removeDotSegments.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a relative URI against a base URI, delegating to UriResolver::resolve.

methods.name: withoutQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI with a specific query key removed.

methods.name: withQueryValue
methods.description: Creates a new URI with a specific query key set or replaced.

methods.name: withQueryValues
methods.description: Creates a new URI with multiple query key-value pairs set.

methods.name: fromParts
methods.description: Creates a URI instance from an array of parse_url components, validating the result.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the URI scheme.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Assembles and returns the authority component (user info, host, port).

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user information part of the URI.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the URI.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new URI with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new URI with updated user info.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new URI with the hostname changed.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new URI with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new URI with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new URI with the specified query string.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new URI with the specified fragment.
